Photo 1 shows the same unit from a slightly different angle, with the brand name visible on the top front panel.
The unit has a black fan grille, a control panel with a dial and buttons, and a power cord with a 3-pin plug on the floor.
The unit appears to be in a room with tiled flooring and a window with bars in the background.
There is visible wear and dirt on the front grille and lower body, especially in photo 1.
No power cord is visible in photo 0, but it is present in photo 1.
